properties.name: spring.flyway.enabled
properties.description: Whether Flyway auto-migration runs at startup.

properties.name: spring.flyway.validate-on-migrate
properties.description: Validate applied migrations against available ones before migrating.

properties.name: spring.flyway.baseline-on-migrate
properties.description: Baseline a non-empty schema on first migrate instead of failing. Must stay false here: all environments start from versioned V1.

properties.name: spring.flyway.url
properties.description: JDBC URL Flyway uses. Dev: same as the datasource. Prod: Neon DIRECT endpoint (port 5432) — DDL must bypass PgBouncer; the app runtime uses the pooled endpoint instead.

properties.name: spring.flyway.locations
properties.description: Classpath locations of versioned Flyway migrations.

properties.name: vaadin.productionMode
properties.description: Vaadin deployment mode. false: Vite dev server with hot reload. true: pre-built production bundle (set via the production Maven profile).
